gloss: chestnut in its spiny husk; close-cropped (spiky) hair

definitions.explanation: A chestnut still enclosed in its prickly green outer burr ({毬|いが}). The fully ripe form that drops from the tree before being opened.
By metaphor, a very short hairstyle that resembles the bristly burr of a chestnut. Often used affectionately for young boys.

examples.japanese: {毬栗|いがぐり}が{道|みち}に{落|お}ちていた。
examples.english: There was a spiny chestnut burr lying on the road.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると{毬栗|いがぐり}が{木|き}から{落|お}ちてくる。
examples.english: When autumn comes, spiny chestnut burrs fall from the trees.

examples.japanese: {足|あし}で{毬栗|いがぐり}を{踏|ふ}むと{靴|くつ}に{棘|とげ}が{刺|さ}さって{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: If you step on a spiny chestnut burr, the spines stick into your shoes and it hurts.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}は{毬栗|いがぐり}{頭|あたま}にした。
examples.english: My younger brother got a buzz cut.

examples.japanese: {毬栗|いがぐり}{頭|あたま}の{男|おとこ}の{子|こ}が{校門|こうもん}から{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: A boy with a buzz cut came out of the school gate.

examples.japanese: {部活|ぶかつ}の{野球部員|やきゅうぶいん}たちはみんな{毬栗|いがぐり}{頭|あたま}にしている。
examples.english: The members of the baseball club all have buzz cuts.

notes:
Compound of {毬|いが} (the prickly burr of a chestnut) + {栗|ぐり} (chestnut). The hair-cut sense is always used with {頭|あたま} or {刈|か}り.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毬栗|いがぐり}{頭|あたま}: buzz cut (literally "chestnut-burr head")
- {毬栗|いがぐり}{刈|が}り: a close-cropped haircut
- {毬栗|いがぐり}が{落|お}ちる: spiny chestnuts fall (from the tree)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {栗|くり}: chestnut — the nut itself, without the burr
- {坊主頭|ぼうずあたま}: shaved head — even shorter than {毬栗|いがぐり}{頭|あたま}
